options.name: access_token
options.description: An OAuth2 access token if credential type is accesstoken.

options.name: cert
options.description: PEM representation of the X.509 certificate.

options.name: cert_serial_number
options.description: Serial number, as extracted from the certificate.

options.name: create_time
options.description: The time when the certificate was created in RFC 3339 format, for example 2012-11-15T16:19:00.094Z.

options.name: env_type
options.description: Specifies which Ansible environment you're running this module within. This should not be set unless you know what you're doing. This only alters the User Agent string for any API requests.

options.name: expiration_time
options.description: The time when the certificate expires in RFC 3339 format, for example 2012-11-15T16:19:00.094Z.

options.name: instance
options.description: The name of the Cloud SQL instance. This does not include the project ID. This field represents a link to a Instance resource in GCP. It can be specified in two ways. First, you can place a dictionary with key 'name' and value of your resource's name Alternatively, you can add `register: name-of-resource` to a gcp_sql_instance task and then set this instance field to "{{ name-of-resource }}"

options.name: private_key
options.description: The private key associated with the certificate.

options.name: project
options.description: The Google Cloud Platform project to use.

options.name: scopes
options.description: Array of scopes to be used

options.name: service_account_contents
options.description: The contents of a Service Account JSON file, either in a dictionary or as a JSON string that represents it.

options.name: service_account_email
options.description: An optional service account email address if machineaccount is selected and the user does not wish to use the default email.

options.name: service_account_file
options.description: The path of a Service Account JSON file if serviceaccount is selected as type.

options.name: state
options.description: Whether the given object should exist in GCP
